Definition
[Finite-time singularity model] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0061 1. ch28:28.7\group Singularity Models

An associated singularity model is a complete nonflat ancient pointed Cheeger--Gromov limit of $g_i(t)=K_i g(t_i+K_i^{-1}t)$, where $t_i\to T$ and $K_i\to \infty $.
